{
  "opportunities": [
    {
      "kind": "trend",
      "title": "Linen and knitwear fit the relaxed urban trend",
      "why": "The profile highlights a focus on linen and knitwear for urban professionals, and since no external search data is available, this aligns with the brand’s stated direction toward effortless daily wear.",
      "action": "Post the linen dress and Fair Isle sweater on Tuesday and Saturday with close-up texture shots.",
      "estimate_usd_month": 80,
      "confidence": "medium",
      "source": "profile"
    },
    {
      "kind": "upsell",
      "title": "Layer the denim jacket over the linen dress",
      "why": "Both items are in the store’s catalog, and styling them together supports the ‘everyday styling and comfort’ content pillar. This approach encourages multiple-item purchases without requiring new inventory.",
      "action": "Add a ‘Shop the Look’ section on the product pages showing the jacket layered over the dress.",
      "estimate_usd_month": 120,
      "confidence": "medium",
      "source": "profile"
    },
    {
      "kind": "channel",
      "title": "Use Instagram to showcase texture close-ups",
      "why": "The target audience of urban creatives responds well to visual storytelling, and the profile’s best post hint specifically recommends close-up texture shots to highlight craftsmanship.",
      "action": "Schedule three Instagram posts this month featuring the denim stitching, cuff embroidery, and knit pattern.",
      "estimate_usd_month": 90,
      "confidence": "medium",
      "source": "profile"
    }
  ]
}
